question: Which academy was the runner-up in the Bakshi Cup 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Defence Academy (NDA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bakshi Cup 2025** was the **10th edition** of the Inter-Academy Sports Meet, a prestigious event that brings together the premier officer training institutions of India.
 
• The **Indian Military Academy (IMA)**, located in **Dehradun**, hosted the 2025 edition of the tournament from **6th February to 11th February 2025**.
 
• The **Indian Military Academy (IMA)** emerged as the overall winner of the **Bakshi Cup 2025**, reclaiming the trophy on its home turf.
 
• The **National Defence Academy (NDA)**, situated in **Khadakwasla, Pune**, secured the position of the **runner-up** in the competition after a neck-and-neck struggle for points in the final tally. ***Hence, the correct option is National Defence Academy (NDA).***
 
• The tournament featured participation from five major academies: **IMA Dehradun**, **NDA Khadakwasla**, **Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala**, **Air Force Academy (AFA) Dundigal**, and **Officers' Training Academy (OTA) Chennai**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bakshi Cup Overview:**
 
 
• The **Bakshi Cup** was instituted in the memory of **Lieutenant General P.S. Bakshi**, a former **Commandant of the IMA**, to promote sportsmanship and healthy competition among trainee officers.
 
• It serves as a platform for **Gentleman Cadets (GCs)** and **Flight Cadets** to exhibit their physical prowess, teamwork, and leadership qualities.
 
• The competition traditionally includes disciplines such as **Cross Country**, **Boxing**, **Football**, **Basketball**, **Hockey**, and **Volleyball**.
 
 
 
• **Participating Academies Details:**
 
 
• **Indian Military Academy (IMA):** Founded in **1932** in **Dehradun, Uttarakhand**, it is the oldest army training academy in India. Its motto is **"Veerta Aur Vivek"** (Valour and Wisdom).
 
• **National Defence Academy (NDA):** Established in **1954** at **Khadakwasla, Maharashtra**, it is the first **tri-service academy** in the world, training cadets for the Army, Navy, and Air Force together. Its motto is **"Seva Parmo Dharma"** (Service Before Self).
 
• **Air Force Academy (AFA):** Located in **Dundigal, Hyderabad**, it was established in **1969** and began operations in **1971**. It provides training to all personnel of the **Indian Air Force**.
 
• **Officers' Training Academy (OTA) Chennai:** Established in **1963**, it focuses on training officers for the **Short Service Commission (SSC)** in the Indian Army.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In the 2025 edition, the **Cross Country** race, often considered the most grueling and decisive event of the meet, saw intense competition between **IMA** and **NDA** cadets.
 
• The **Bakshi Cup** is held biennially or annually depending on the training schedule and rotates its hosting rights among the participating academies.
 
• The **10th edition** in **2025** emphasized the integration of **modern sports technology** and rigorous physical standards required for future military leaders.
 
• Winning the **Bakshi Cup** is considered a matter of immense pride for the academies, reflecting the quality of physical training and the competitive spirit of the **cadets**.
